subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are coloured Red, Green, Blue, Yellow, Black, White.

Select the colour that will be the face opposite to the one coloured Black.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41aae4d7b8de509a20ecc6d8b4153f1be1a59174d65d7baec0720a5ac09f9ccc.png]
solution:
Here, we can see that. they have given 2 dices and have 2 common faces.

So, we will arrange the 2nd dice in such a way that it common faces are arranged in same way as 1st dice.

Thus, the red colour will be opposite to black.

Hence, the __**red**__ colour will be opposite to black colour.
